entities.name: Khalifah bin Said Al Busaidi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sayyid Khalifa I bin Said al-Busaidi, GCMG, was the third Sultan of Zanzibar. He ruled Zanzibar from 26 March 1888 to 13 February 1890 and was succeeded by his brother, Ali bin Said.
